newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Quad Cities 1 nuke in startup mode.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Quad Cities 1 nuke in startup mode.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities 1 nuclear unit was in startup mode early Monday after shutting down last Tuesday for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its status report.
The unit, in Cordova, Ill., was operating at one percent power this morning and undergoing testing, the NRC report stated.
The unit was taken off line last Tuesday to repair an electronic relay system.
The adjacent unit 2, with an identical generating capacity, is still shut for a refueling outage scheduled to end in early May.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
